home_title: Your family's finances, in one place
home_intro: Track the money coming in and going out of every account, personal or shared, and see where it goes.
not_found_text: This page doesn't exist or has moved.
sign_in_intro: Enter your email: we'll send you a link to sign in, no password needed. New here? Your account is created on the way.
check_email_text: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this device to continue.
welcome_intro: What's your name? It's shown in your account.
error_invalid_otp: This code is wrong. Check the latest email we sent.
error_otp_expired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
error_too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one.
error_name_too_long: Your name is too long (60 characters at most).
error_network: Grand Livre can't be reached. Check your connection and try again.
error_too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error_save_failed: Your change couldn't be saved. Try again.
profile_intro: Your name is shown in your account.
pwa_description: Family finances: accounts, income and expenses, in one place.
offline_text: Grand Livre needs a connection to show this page. It will reload by itself once you're back online.
install_text: Open Grand Livre in one tap from your home screen, like an app.
install_ios_title: Add Grand Livre to your home screen
install_ios_step_share: Tap the Share button, in the browser's toolbar.
install_ios_step_add: Choose “Add to Home Screen”. Don't see it? Scroll down the list.
install_ios_sign_in: Then open Grand Livre from your home screen: you'll sign in once more there, with a code we email you.
sign_in_intro_code: Enter your email: we'll send you a code to sign in, no password needed. New here? Your account is created on the way.
setup_intro: A household gathers the family's accounts. Create yours, or join one you were invited to.
household_currency_hint: Every amount of the household is in this currency.
error_household_name_required: Enter a name for the household.
error_household_name_too_long: The household's name is too long (60 characters at most).
error_household_currency_invalid: Choose a currency from the list.
error_invitation_not_found: This invitation is no longer valid.
household_intro: The name, the currency and the members of your household.
member_remove_text: They will no longer see the household's accounts. You can invite them again later.
household_leave_text: You will no longer see its accounts. An owner can invite you again.
invite_intro: Invite a member of the family by email. They join the household by signing in with that address.
error_last_owner: A household needs at least one owner. Make another member an owner first.
error_already_member: This person is already a member of the household.
error_email_unavailable: The email couldn't be sent. Try again in a moment.
accounts_intro: Every account of the household, with its balance.
account_opening_balance_hint: The balance of the account before the first transaction you record here.
account_amount_owed_hint: What is owed on this account today, without a minus sign.
account_holders_hint: Holders record and change the account's transactions. With several holders, it is a shared account.
account_delete_text: The account and its balance leave the household's total. This can't be undone.
account_read_only: Only the holders of this account can change it.
error_account_name_required: Enter a name for the account.
error_account_name_too_long: The account's name is too long (60 characters at most).
error_account_holders_invalid: These holders aren't all members of the household.
error_currency_locked: The currency can't change once the household has accounts.
error_forbidden: You aren't allowed to do this.
tags_intro: The categories of the household's income and expenses. A tag can hold other, more precise tags.
tag_names_hint: One language is enough: the members who use another one see that name until theirs is filled in.
tag_delete_text: A tag that has sub-tags can't be deleted. This can't be undone.
error_tag_name_required: Enter a name in at least one language.
error_tag_name_too_long: This name is too long (40 characters at most).
error_tag_name_taken: Another tag at the same level already has this name.
error_tag_parent_invalid: A tag can't be placed under itself or one of its sub-tags.
error_tag_has_children: This tag has sub-tags: move or delete them first.
error_tag_limit_reached: The household has reached its maximum number of tags.
suggested_tags_intro: Uncheck what doesn't concern your household. You can rename, move or delete these tags afterwards.
error_suggested_tags_invalid: This list of tags is out of date. Reload the page.
transactions_intro: The money coming in and going out of the household's accounts, most recent first.
transaction_no_account: A transaction is recorded on an account you hold. Add one first.
transaction_read_only: Only the holders of its account can change this transaction.
transaction_delete_text: The balance of its account will go back to what it was. This can't be undone.
error_amount_not_positive: Enter an amount greater than zero.
error_transaction_account_invalid: This account is no longer available. Choose another one.
error_transaction_tag_invalid: This tag no longer exists. Choose another one.
error_transaction_lines_too_many: A transaction can't be split into more than 50 lines.
error_transaction_payee_too_long: This name is too long (80 characters at most).
error_transaction_note_too_long: This note is too long (500 characters at most).
error_transfer_same_account: Choose a different account: a transfer goes from one account to another.
error_account_archived: This account is archived: it takes no new transaction, and its transactions can't be changed.
error_account_has_transactions: This account has transactions: it can't be deleted, only archived.
error_tag_in_use: This tag has transactions: it can't be deleted.
account_archive_hint: An archived account keeps its transactions and still counts in the household's balance, but takes no new transaction. An account that has transactions can't be deleted, only archived.
account_archived_notice: This account is archived: it takes no new transaction, and its transactions can't be changed.
toast_account_unarchived: The account is back in use.
reports_intro: What the household earned and spent, tag by tag. A tag counts its sub-tags, and its refunds lower what it cost.
report_accounts_note: Reports count every account of the household, including those whose balance only you see. Transfers between accounts count neither as income nor as expenses.
error_report_period_invalid: Choose a first day that comes before the last.
error_report_period_too_long: This period is too long (5 years at most).
transactions_hidden_note: The transactions of the accounts whose balance only you see aren't listed here, but count in the reports: a report's total can be higher than what is listed.
report_tag_transactions_label: See the transactions of {name} over this period
quick_entry_hint: Type it or dictate it with your keyboard's microphone. The assistant prepares the transaction: you check it before it is saved.
receipt_scan_hint: Take a photo of a receipt, or choose one. The assistant prepares the expense, tag by tag; the photo isn't kept.
draft_warning_receipt_total_mismatch: The items and taxes read on the receipt don't add up to its total: the amounts follow the total. Check them against the receipt.
error_receipt_not_understood: The assistant couldn't read this receipt. Try a sharper photo, or fill in the form below.
error_receipt_photo_required: Choose a photo of the receipt.
error_receipt_photo_invalid: This file isn't a photo the assistant can read. Choose a JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF image.
error_receipt_photo_too_large: This photo is too large (5 MB at most).
proposed_tag_title: New tag proposed by the assistant
proposed_tag_hint: It will be created when you record the transaction, unless you choose otherwise.
proposed_tag_similar_title: Existing tags that look like it
error_draft_text_too_long: This note is too long (500 characters at most).
error_draft_not_understood: The assistant couldn't find a transaction in this note. Add an amount, or fill in the form below.
error_assistant_unavailable: The assistant is unavailable for now. Fill in the form below.
recurring_intro: The transactions that come back: a rent, a subscription, a pay. On their day they are recorded on their own, or wait for you to confirm them.
recurring_form_hint: Changing it later only changes the transactions to come.
recurring_read_only: Only the holders of its account can change it.
recurring_mode_confirm_hint: It waits for you to check it, its amount open to change: a power bill, a phone bill.
recurring_mode_automatic_hint: It is recorded on its own: a rent, a subscription, always the same amount.
recurring_delete_text: It won't record anything anymore. The transactions it already recorded stay.
household_time_zone_hint: Recurring transactions are recorded when their day starts here.
error_household_time_zone_invalid: Choose a time zone from the list.
error_recurrence_interval_invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 99.
error_recurrence_mode_invalid: Choose whether it is automatic or to confirm.
error_recurrence_end_before_start: The last date can't come before the first.
error_recurrence_start_in_past: Choose today or a later day. What already happened is entered as transactions.
error_occurrence_already_handled: This date was already recorded or skipped.
pending_recurring_intro: These recurring transactions have come due: check them, then record them, or skip them.
occurrence_skip_text: Nothing will be recorded for {date}. The recurring transaction goes on.
occurrence_confirm_intro: {name}, due on {date}. Check the amount and the details, then record it.
occurrence_handled: This date was already recorded or skipped.
recurring_from_intro: Made from a transaction: check how often it comes back, and from when.
budgets_intro: What you mean to spend on each category, and where you stand. A budget on a tag covers the tags under it.
budget_planned_over: Will be over by {amount} with what is planned
budget_period_month_hint: Groceries, outings: what comes back every month.
budget_period_year_hint: Insurance, holidays, gifts: what comes once or twice a year.
budget_from_hint: This month and the following ones; the months before keep their budget.
budget_stop_text: From {month}, this tag has no budget. The months before keep it.
error_budget_tag_required: Choose the tag of the budget.
error_budget_period_invalid: Choose each month or each year.
sharing_intro: Who owes whom for the expenses shared between members, and how to settle.
settlement_delete_text: The balances go back to what they were before it.
settlement_delete_text_transfer: The transfer recorded with it is deleted too, and the balances go back to what they were before it.
settle_transfer_label: Also record the transfer between our accounts
settle_transfer_hint: From one of your accounts to one of theirs: the balances of the accounts follow.
share_toggle_hint: Paid from your own account for others too: they will owe you their part.
share_equal_hint: Split in equal parts among the members checked.
share_weights_hint: Each one's part follows their number: 1 and 1 is halves, 60 and 40 is 60 %.
share_amounts_hint: The amounts must add up to the transaction's.
household_sharing_hint: For households where each one pays their part. Off, nothing about it shows.
error_sharing_disabled: This household doesn't settle shared expenses.
error_share_members_required: Choose who it is shared with.
error_share_members_invalid: Each member can be named once.
error_share_member_invalid: Someone chosen is no longer a member of the household.
error_share_weight_invalid: Enter whole numbers, at least one above 0.
error_share_amounts_mismatch: The amounts must add up to the transaction's.
error_share_account_not_personal: Only an expense paid from an account with a single holder can be shared: a joint account is already common money.
error_settlement_note_too_long: This note is too long (200 characters at most).
error_settlement_account_invalid: Choose an account of the one who pays, and one of the one paid.
